## CANDIDA VULVOVAGINITIS
Candida vulvovaginitis typically presents with valvular irritation, burning or
pruritus. Vaginal pH should be measured, and the specimen should be examined
under the microscope for clue cells (epithelial cell coated with bacteria) to
exclude bacterial vaginosis. In candida vulvovaginitis, the vaginal pH is
typically normal (4-4.5) and vaginal discharge is typically thick and curdy with
white plaques on vaginal mucosa. Diagnosis is confirmed by identifying fungus or
yeast with KOH prep.
Most non-C. albicans species respond to fluconazole treatment except C. krusei
and C. glabrata. C. krusei can be treated with topical agents as for complicated
candida vulvovaginitis below. C. glabrata treatment is complicated and azole
therapy is frequently unsuccessful. Consult Infectious Diseases in patients with
C. glabrata vulvovaginitis.
Recurrent candida vulvovaginitis is treated as complicated candida
vulvovaginitis for induction treatment, followed by maintenance regimen for 6
months.
## Candida vulvovaginitis in pregnancy:
## Inpatient

[Clotrimazole vaginal cream 1% 1 applicatorful qhs for 7 days](psjzid-clotrimazole-vaginal-crm-1-1-applful-qhs)
## Treatment of uncomplicated candida vulvovaginitis
[Fluconazole 150 mg PO once ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-fluconazole-150mg-po-once)
< OR >
Clotrimazole vaginal 1% cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 7 to 14 days
< OR >
[Terconazole 0.4% vaginal cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 7 days](psjzid-terconazole-0-4-crm-vag-qhs)
## Treatment of complicated candida vulvovaginitis (e.g. immunocompromised, severe
## disease) or recurrent infection induction treatment
[Fluconazole 150 mg PO q72h for 7 days (3 doses) ($) [R,DI]](psjzid-fluconazole-150mg-po-q72h)
< OR >
Clotrimazole vaginal 1% cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 10-14 days
< OR >
Terconazole 0.4% vaginal cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 10-14 days
## Recurrent candida vulvovaginitis maintenance regimen following induction
## treatment above
[Fluconazole 150 mg PO every 7 days ($) [R,DI] for 6 months](psjzid-fluconazole-150mg-po-qweek)
## Treatment of C. glabrata vulvovaginitis
Failure of azole therapy is common, alternative topical treatments below require
compounding by a pharmacist. Please call pharmacy to order.
Topical boric acid capsule 600 mg intravaginal qhs for 14 days

Non-VA order for above

Terconazole 0.4% vaginal cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 7 days
Non-VA order for above

## disease, pregnancy) or recurrent infection induction treatment
Fluconazole 150 mg PO q72h for 7 days (3 doses) ($) [R,DI]
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
[Clotrimazole vaginal 1% cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 10 days](psozid2-clotrimazole-vag-1-crm-1-app-qhs-10ds)
Non-VA order for above
< OR >
[Terconazole 0.4% vaginal cream 1 applicator full qhs ($) [M] for 10 days](psozid2-terconazole-0-4-vag-crm-qhs-10ds)
Non-VA order for above
## Recurrent candida vulvovaginitis maintenance regimen following induction
## treatment above
Fluconazole 150 mg PO every 7 days ($) [R,DI] for 6 months
Non-VA order for above
## Treatment of C. glabrata vulvovaginitis
Failure of azole therapy is common, alternative topical treatments below require
compounding by a pharmacist. Enter Outpatient Rx for CPD-BORIC ACID CAP,VAG.
Topical boric acid capsule 600 mg intravaginal qhs for 14 days
